title: Smart Future Cities India - Visitor Profile
description: The Smart Future Cities India expo plays a major role in promoting the vision of the Smart Cities Mission and subsequently its success. While the government is constantly working towards improving the health standards of our citizens, a lot needs to be done and this can happen through active private and citizen participation. This event serves as an excellent platform to interact and network with players of all fields related to smart cities.
